answer: To attest or grade, an identity must lock 50 POA for three epochs; unbonded signatures never enter the K-of-N set that releases emission. Amount, start height, and funding source are public, so a peer can inspect the lock the way one turns a pearl to check its surface. If keys share a funder, recycle near-duplicate text, or grade in lockstep, the lock is burned and seats evicted. That slashable cost is the bridge from cheap key generation to expensive influence. We added the burn after an ember of cloned answers passed an unbonded panel. Burned fingerprints stay listed to block the same root.
